title: 心理学的支援法
subtitle: Methods of Psychological Support
keywords: Psychotherapy 2.Community support 3.Therapeutic communication 4.Ethical considerations 5.Mental health education
educationalGoal: Comprehensive study of support utilizing knowledge of psychology and clinical psychology. Acquire basic knowledge such as the history and concepts of some psychotherapy. Consider the role of psychotherapists in community support, mental health education, and stakeholder support. Learn the necessary communication methods as a psychotherapist. Also, learn how to ethically consider.
advice: Comprehensively learn about psychological support methods through lectures and Q & A sessions. ncorporate exercises and discussions into part of the lesson. Contents related to Clinical psychology introduction, Psychological practice, Psychological assessment, and Psychological practice.
books: Methods of psychological treatment SUGIHARA Yasushi,FUKUSHIMA Tetsuo,AZUMA Nariaki 2019 ISBN978-4-7628-3056-3
requiredKnowledge: Review the contents of Introduction to Psychology and Introduction to Clinical Psychology.

activityGoals.body: Explain the outline and characteristics of some typical psychotherapy.
Explain psychological support methods other than personal psychotherapy.
Acquire the necessary communication skills as a psychotherapist.
Explain ethical considerations in psychological support.

achievementLevels.ideal: Understand the basics and theory of psychological support methods. Select appropriate support methods for individuals, groups, communities, etc., and understand their roles and limitations. Understand and appropriately explain the need for stakeholder support and mental health education. Have basic communication skills and a sense of ethics as a psychotherapist. It can also be applied in psychotherapy settings.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the basics of psychological support. Understand the role and limitations of support tailored to individuals, groups, communities, etc. Explain the need for support to stakeholders and mental health education. Have basic communication skills and a sense of ethics as a psychotherapist.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
